class.name: Terrain3DTextureAsset
class.description: A terrain surface layer added to a [Terrain3DAssets] resource. Choose [member source_mode] to use prepared texture files or an editor-baked [StandardMaterial3D]/[ORMMaterial3D]. Switching modes preserves both configurations. Both modes use unified texture arrays. Caches can be embedded or saved as external .res resources; save the assets after preprocessing and before exporting.

method.name: bake_material
method.description: Prepares the selected source mode's lossless packed texture cache. A size of zero uses [member material_texture_size]. Unchanged inputs reuse the cache. Compression is editor-only; exported games require a valid saved cache. The assets resource selects a common array resolution and prepares platform GPU variants separately.

method.name: clear
method.description: Clears the texture files and settings.

method.name: get_highlight_color
method.description: Returns the color of the current highlight, if any.

method.name: is_highlighted
method.description: Returns true if this texture is currently highlighted on the ground. For editor use.

method.name: set_highlighted
method.description: Enables or disables adding a random highlight color to this texture wherever placed on the ground.

members.member: Stores caches inside the owning resource or in external content-addressed binary .res files. Both source modes support this setting.
Project directory for external lossless masters and GPU variants. Existing shared files are retained when storage settings change.
Read-only path of the external lossless master.
Selects prepared texture files or a PBR material. The inspector displays the controls for the selected mode.

Source [StandardMaterial3D] or [ORMMaterial3D]. Supported channels are albedo, normal, height, roughness, metallic, ambient occlusion and emission. UV1 scale/offset, tint, normal strength, specular and AO light affect are transferred. Independent lighting models, transparency, additional passes and custom shaders are not transferred.

Bakes AO into albedo in linear color space and removes independent AO shading. This can darken directly lit surfaces and metallic reflections. An unused auxiliary map is omitted, but emission remains supported and may still require that map.
Requested baking resolution. All material layers in the same assets resource use the largest requested resolution. The assets resource selects the shared resolution and GPU compression profile.
Read-only notes for source material features that the terrain adapter cannot transfer.
This color is multiplied by the albedo texture in the shader.
The texture file with albedo on RGB and height on A. This is an authoring input. Exported runtime copies use their unified texture cache and omit the source texture reference.

This value is applied directly to the AO_LIGHT_AFFECT in the shader, which dictates how much ambient occlusion affects light from Light3Ds. 0 means AO only affects ambient light. 1 means it also affects lights.

The strength of ambient occlusion, which darkens areas of this texture dictated by the ambient occlusion map. If you have not provided an AO texture, an AO value is approximated by the normal map automatically.
The shader rotates UV lookups in a detiling pattern based on this value.
The shader laterally shifts UV lookups in a detiling pattern based on this value.
Offset that can be used to raise or lower the displaced surface height for this material. Example: slightly lowering a cobblestone texture so the tops of the cobbles match collision.
The scale of the displaced surface height for this material.
The user settable ID of the texture, between 0 and 31. You can change this to reorder textures in the list, however it won't change the ID painted on the terrain.
A user specified name for this texture set.
Increases or decreases the strength of the normal texture.
The texture file with normal on RGB and roughness on A. This is an authoring input. Exported runtime copies use their unified texture cache and omit the source texture reference.
Increases or decreases the roughness texture values.
The scale of the textures.

signal.name: file_changed
signal.description: Emitted when texture files or material pixels need rebuilding.

signal.name: id_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [member id] is changed with the AssetType (TYPE_TEXTURE or TYPE_MESH), and old and new IDs.

signal.name: setting_changed
signal.description: Emitted when any setting is changed, other than id, albedo_texture, or normal_texture.
